posts.author: CeaCeaCea
posts.body:
Hi all,
This might be a noob thread but
I’m working on a custom RPG using RPG Maker MZ. I commissioned a pixel artist to create a
fully custom side-view battler sprite
for one of my main characters. I’m hoping to get help from someone who understands either:
How to format the sprite into a usable sheet
OR how to configure it for use with a specific plugin.
Sprite Details:​
Frame size:
84x84 px
Each animation (e.g. Idle, Attack, Defend) has
more than 3 frames
(e.g. Idle has 6)
Format: Each frame is currently an
individual PNG file
per folder (e.g. Idle/Idle1.png, Idle2.png, etc.)
As far as I understood it, RPG Maker’s default SV_Actor sheet only supports 3 frames per motion? but my artist’s work has
4–8 frames
per motion — and I’d like to preserve that for smoother animations...
I don’t want to lose frames or cram everything into a 9×6 grid if I don’t have to.
Attached photos are the example 1-6 frames of the battler's Idle animation...
Any help is appreciated!

posts.author: MiniMiniMantis
posts.body:
Ayyo I'm a noob too I have been using the visustella dragonbones plugin strat, it has been working well for me for putting however many frames I need for attacks/idles/whateva. Those individual sprites are what you need for it. I'm sure there's other more modern and stylish techniques but this has been working well for someone with no skills or brains like me. Here's to us hopefully not getting banned in the future for being too noobish! Cheers
(i like your character)
